chunks: Then eighteen nights passed for her, and he did not say that he ordered her to remain seated for eighteen nights. Rather, he only ordered her, after the eighteen nights, to perform salat (prayer).

key_terms.بَعْدَ الثَّمَانِيَ عَشْرَةَ لَيْلَةً: after eighteen nights; the point at which the ruling changes
key_terms.بِالْقُعُودِ: remaining seated; refraining from ritual activity
key_terms.ثَمَانِيَ عَشْرَةَ لَيْلَةً: eighteen nights; the time period under discussion

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم order a woman in nifas to refrain for eighteen nights, or to resume salat after them?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies that the instruction was not to refrain for the entire eighteen nights as an explicit command of sitting out, but that after eighteen nights she was instructed to resume salat (prayer). It is used in the context of jurisprudential discussion on postnatal bleeding and the timing of ritual acts.
